taboo_rules_catalog.name: Indirect Reflection Protocol
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Never meet its direct gaze or charge head-on; track its position strictly through reflections, camera feeds, or peripheral sight.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Angle a reflective surface or optical sensor to lock its parallax silhouette before activating the containment seal.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Witnesses who looked directly into its aperture suffered immediate cognitive lock, whereas security cameras captured its true anchor point.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Meeting the anomaly's direct gaze triggered a violent cognito-reflective backlash!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Acoustic Non-Response Mandate
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Never answer its vocal mimicry with your real name or direct aggression; reply only in paradoxical riddles or white-noise frequencies.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Broadcast an inverted acoustic phase-loop or offer a decoy pseudonym while anchoring its vocal core.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Audio logs show the anomaly steals vocal cords only after a victim acknowledges its call by name.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Answering the anomaly's acoustic mimicry empowered its vocal resonance!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Endothermic Starvation Protocol
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Absorbs open flame and high-temperature plasma to multiply; never apply thermal or incendiary force.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Flood the perimeter with endothermic cryo-mist, pressurized water, or vacuum-seal foam to starve its heat sink.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Scorched walls around the breach are freezing cold to the touch—it feeds greedily on ambient heat and open fire.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Thermal energy fed the anomaly's endothermic core, regenerating its mass!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Faraday Grounding Mandate
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Siphons live electrical current and arc discharges; sever nearby breakers and never strike it with ungrounded electric current.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Drive a copper grounding spike into the substrate and isolate the anomaly inside an insulated Faraday lattice.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Every transformer within two blocks was drained dry seconds before the manifestation stabilized.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Electrical discharge supercharged the anomaly's parasitic capacitor!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Non-Newtonian Impulse Clause
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Its shell hardens exponentially against brute-force kinetic impacts; avoid raw physical slams and high-caliber concussive fire.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Apply slow, steady harmonic resonance or elemental phase-disruption to dissolve its non-Newtonian lattice.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Ballistic gel tests show high-velocity slugs shatter harmlessly against its surface while slow tuning-fork vibrations pass right through.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Brute kinetic impact rebounded off the anomaly's non-Newtonian shell!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Hemostatic Quarantine Rule
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Enters a feeding frenzy upon detecting open bleeding or bio-toxic spores; never use biological toxins or unsealed lacerations.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Sanitize the air with consecrated salt, cauterizing heat, or astringent incense to blind its chemoreceptors.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Traces of consecrated salt and sterile antiseptic completely masked the survivor's trail from the specimen.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Bio-chemical residue triggered a predatory feeding surge in the anomaly!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Continuous Line-of-Sight Lock
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Teleports and strikes only when unobserved or during sudden panic movements; never turn your back or sprint blindly.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Maintain unbroken alternating eye contact or strobe-flare illumination while sliding the containment tether into place.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Scrapes on the concrete stop abruptly whenever floodlights or unblinking observers hold it in frame.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Breaking line-of-sight allowed the anomaly to phase-shift behind you!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Ritual Reciprocity Pact
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Bound by archaic threshold and toll laws; attacking or seizing it without offering a symbolic fare or bow invokes a crushing curse.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Present a symbolic coin, paper talisman, or formal declaration of passage before sealing its vessel.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: An antique fare box beside the manifestation still clicks open whenever a brass coin or paper slip is presented.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Violating the threshold toll without an offering triggered a crushing ritual penalty!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Desiccation & Drainage Protocol
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Propagates through standing water and high humidity; never douse it with water or aqueous solutions.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Drain surrounding conduits and calcify the damp floor with geomantic earth or high-voltage arcs.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: The manifestation cannot cross dry chalk lines or drained concrete channels.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Moisture expanded the anomaly's hydro-conductive reach!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Arithmomania Distraction Clause
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Bound by obsessive counting and sorting laws; physically blocking its route triggers violent kinetic backlash.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Scatter small coins, beads, or dried grains across the floor to force an obsessive counting reset while sealing its anchor.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Surveillance footage shows the anomaly halting mid-stride for eleven minutes to count spilled transit tokens one by one.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Physically obstructing the anomaly's compulsive route triggered a violent kinetic lash-back!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Deadpan Etiquette Mandate
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Feeds strictly on startled gasps, flinching, and panicked flight; sprinting or shouting empowers its scare-aura.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Maintain an unflinching deadpan expression, step politely aside, and recite a calm threshold courtesy ('After you') before closing the seal.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Passersby who screamed or bolted lost consciousness from sheer terror, while an unbothered janitor who nodded politely walked straight past it.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Flinching and sudden panic fed the anomaly's startle-resonance!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Counterfeit Tell & Fair-Play Clause
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Delights in illusion swaps and playful wagers; swinging wildly with brute force causes it to swap places with a decoy.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Spot the counterfeit leaf-seam or humor its playful riddle wager to trick it into stepping inside the containment circle.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Every stolen banknote recovered near the site reverted into a damp camellia leaf the moment someone called out its backward serial number.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Brute force shattered an illusory decoy while the trickster anomaly laughed from behind you!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Shadow-Separation Mandate
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Anchors victims by stepping across their cast shadow; never stand beneath direct overhead backlighting or rush into its umbra.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Diffuse surrounding light sources so no sharp shadow touches {anchor_fixture} while locking the containment seal.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Victims were paralyzed without a single physical mark—each stood directly between a streetlamp and the manifestation's dark outline.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Stepping within the anomaly's shadow-reach pinned your silhouette and triggered an umbral lash!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Apnea & Vital-Masking Clause
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Tracks targets strictly through warm exhaled CO2 and spoken breath; shouting or heavy sprinting draws instant homing strikes.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Hold your breath completely and mask warm exhalations behind a damp cloth or cooling mist while sealing {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Blindfolded test mannequins went untouched until a warm air-vent cycled on, which the entity tore apart in seconds.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Exhaling sharply gave away your vital warmth, drawing an immediate homing strike!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Sovereign Threshold Denial
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Cannot cross sealed lintels or chalked doorframes unless invited or pulled inside; never beckon it or retreat across an unwarded doorway.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Draw an unbroken chalk or salt threshold line and formally revoke right-of-entry before anchoring {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Claw gouges stop at the exact millimeter of the apartment's brass door-sill where the tenant refused to say 'come in'.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Yielding the threshold without a formal denial granted the anomaly right-of-entry!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Cold-Iron & Citrus Astringency Rite
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Regenerates rapidly from mundane bludgeoning and necrotic rot, recoiling only from cold wrought iron and sharp citrus/lime acidity.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Drive a cold-iron spike or anoint the seal perimeter with kaffir lime juice to lock {anchor_fixture} in corporeal stasis.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Rusted wrought-iron railings and crushed kaffir limes left sizzling burn-marks where the entity brushed past.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Ignoring cold-iron warding allowed the anomaly's regenerative shroud to lash back!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Reflective Surface Blackout
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Multiplies and leaps between uncovered mirrors, puddles, and polished glass; never ignite bright flash-flares near reflective panes.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Drape dark cloth or matte spray over nearby glass and puddles to sever its reflection network around {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Every uncovered shopfront window within thirty meters showed the figure standing closer than the last.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Uncovered reflections multiplied the anomaly's angles of attack!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Counter-Cadence Syncopation
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Moves and parries in a locked 4/4 metronomic beat; attacking on-beat is automatically countered.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Clap or step on an irregular off-beat polyrhythm to desynchronize {anchor_fixture} before snapping the seal shut.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Security audio reveals its strikes land at exact 1.25-second intervals, faltering whenever background construction hammered out of time.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Moving on a predictable beat let the anomaly parry in perfect metronomic lockstep!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Luminescence Deprivation Rule
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Feeds on artificial floodlights and high-lumen beams to solidify its projections; shining direct spotlights doubles its reach.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Kill harsh overhead lights and navigate by low infrared or shuttered candlelight to collapse {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Powering up the stadium floodlights caused its silhouette to tower forty feet high; when the fuse blew, it shrank to the size of a cat.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Harsh illumination magnified the anomaly's phototropic projection!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Reverse-Gait Departure Clause
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Interprets forward footsteps as a lethal duel challenge and turned backs as prey; never charge straight in or turn tail.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Approach and withdraw using deliberate backward-facing steps while bowing slightly to {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Muddy shoeprints left by the lone unharmed Shrine warden pointed away from the altar even as he approached it.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Forward aggression violated the reverse-gait taboo, provoking a vicious riposte!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Cursed Hospitality Refusal
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Offers phantom food, coins, or lost keepsakes to bind victims in spiritual debt; accepting or pocketing anything seals your doom.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Politely decline its proffered gift three times with open, empty palms before binding {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Victims found in a trance all clutched illusory gold coins that turned to grave-rot in their pockets.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Touching the anomaly's phantom offering bound you in an immediate debt-curse!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Metallic Resonance Mute
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Shatters containment wards whenever brass, steel, or bells ring aloud; metallic clangs amplify its shockwaves.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Muffle all metal gear with cloth tape and bind {anchor_fixture} using braided hemp cord and wooden pegs.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: A dropped steel wrench caused every window on the floor to implode, whereas wrapped wooden batons made no ripple at all.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Ringing metal resonance amplified the anomaly's acoustic shockwave!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Domestic Hearth Appeasement
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Grows spiteful and destructive when insulted, scolded, or thanked directly with boastful pride; direct threats enrage its domestic claim.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Set down an unboasted saucer of sweet milk, honey cake, or clean linen beside {anchor_fixture} and look away while sealing.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Households that cursed the racket woke up to smashed crockery, while a saucer of warm milk left on the floorboards calmed it instantly.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Hostile disrespect toward the hearth spirit triggered a spiteful telekinetic barrage!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Cranial-Dish & Sumo Bow Protocol
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Draws immense aquatic strength from the water pooled in its cranial dish or basin; grappling it head-on is suicidal.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Offer a carved cucumber or bow deeply so it politely returns the bow—spilling its cranial water—before sealing {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Old riverbank inscriptions note that the creature cannot resist returning a formal bow, even when doing so tips the water from its crown.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Grappling the water-charged entity head-on met crushing hydraulic strength!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Trail-Scrubbing Quarantine
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Regenerates and teleports along any wet footprints or condensation trails it has laid down; leaving its damp tracks intact lets it flank you.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Sweep dry ash, chalk, or absorbent lime across its wet tracks to sever the trail anchoring {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: The entity reappeared exclusively on wet heel-marks it had left minutes earlier; dry swept concrete blocked its return.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Uncared-for wet tracks allowed the anomaly to slip instantly behind your guard!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Phantom Knock Non-Acknowledgement
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Knocks or rings in sets of three to locate living minds; opening a door or calling out on the third knock lets it inside your guard.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Wait through three full knock cycles in stony silence, then tap a single grounding counter-knock on {anchor_fixture} to seal it.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Incident survivors kept bolt-locks untouched through three frantic knocking bursts; those who peeked through the keyhole vanished.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Answering the third phantom knock opened an immediate breach vector!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Karmic Tether Filaments
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Spins nearly invisible crimson fate-threads between targets and {anchor_fixture}; lunging blindly tangles limbs in razor-taut silk.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Spot the faint crimson filaments under angled light and snip them cleanly with consecrated shears or aether-edge before sealing.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: UV forensic sweeps revealed hair-thin red threads strung chest-high across every hallway near the epicenter.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Charging through unseen crimson tether-threads sliced and entangled your advance!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: False-Body Decoy Rule
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Its visible body in open air is an invulnerable mirage while its true core hides inside a nearby reflection or portrait.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Pinpoint the slightly out-of-sync reflection in nearby glass or water and apply the containment seal directly to {anchor_fixture}'s mirrored core.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Bullets passed harmlessly through the figure in the room, yet a crack across the wall mirror made it shriek in pain.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Striking the open-air mirage wasted force and triggered a reflective counter-pulse!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Purified Salt & Rice Ring
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Draws miasma from unclean ground to lash out when cornered; approaching without a purified boundary invites necrotic drain.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Cast an unbroken clockwise circle of coarse sea-salt and glutinous rice around {anchor_fixture} to constrict its miasma.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: A spilled sack of coarse rock-salt at the grocer's threshold burned a smoking crescent into the entity's trailing hem.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Stepping onto unpurified miasma ground drained your vitality!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Non-Binary Evasion Clause
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Traps victims in an absolute 'Yes-or-No' / 'Red-or-Blue' binary choice; giving either direct answer fulfills its curse contract.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Deliver a non-committal, ambiguous third answer ('So-so', 'Neither', 'I am late') to stall its contract loop and seal {anchor_fixture}.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Witnesses who shouted 'Yes' or 'No' were attacked instantly; a flustered student who muttered 'About average, excuse me' walked away unscathed.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Giving a binary Yes/No answer fulfilled the anomaly's curse condition!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Backward Syllable Reversal
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Mimics commands forward to invert them against the speaker; plain-spoken incantations backfire on the caster.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Recite the sealing cadence or street-sign syllables in reverse order to unravel {anchor_fixture}'s linguistic knot.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: Station signage inside the distortion reads right-to-left, and recorded prayers only calmed the spike when played in reverse.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Forward-spoken phrasing was inverted back against your own nervous system!

taboo_rules_catalog.name: Cinnabar Stopper & Talisman Bind
taboo_rules_catalog.taboo_rule: Its roaming form is tethered to an unstoppered jar, bottle, or talismanic seal; striking the projection alone never ends its contract.
taboo_rules_catalog.containment_protocol: Locate the resonant vessel or forehead talisman and press a cinnabar-stamped seal over {anchor_fixture} to lock its contract.
taboo_rules_catalog.clue_hint: A faint umbilical shimmer trails from the entity's spine toward a hidden green glass vessel humming in the rafters.
taboo_rules_catalog.backlash_note: Attacking the projection while ignoring its unsealed tether vessel triggered a violent recoil!

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: The click of vintage heels echoes beneath flickering streetlamps alongside a muffled question from behind a surgical mask.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Rusted upholstery shears drip dark arterial condensation as a split jawbone unhinges from ear to ear beneath a soaked trenchcoat.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Rain-matted vulpine fur bristles beneath a high collar as a masked muzzle parts to reveal twin rows of razor-shearing fangs.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Aged lacquerware creaks with a heartbeat of its own, silk cords coiling likeliving tendons after a century of neglect.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Veins of warm crimson sap pulse through cracked antique wood as bone-white teeth sprout along the relic's seams.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Braided beast-hair tassels lash like living tails as carved claw-marks glow with century-old shrine resentment.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: A deafening ringing fills the ears (`chin-chin`) as calcified skeletal fragments fuse together out of the shadows.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Hundreds of splintered femurs and wet sinew cables grind together into a towering, marrow-weeping thoracic cage.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Calcified wolf-skulls and towering stag antlers interlock with a deafening rattle of starving jaws.

folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Frostbitten blackened fingertips drift through a localized blizzard that flash-freezes exposed capillaries into brittle glass.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Nine frost-rimmed tails trail through a localized whiteout as piercing ice-blue beast eyes gleam in the sleet.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: An overpowering wave of sweet frangipani blossoms suddenly turns to damp grave-earth as distant crying sounds dangerously close—meaning she is already right beside you.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Sweet kemboja perfume curdles into copper blood-stink as a pallid figure with a jagged cranial hollow extends iron-hard talons.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Pale chiropteran wings fold beneath a shroud of frangipani petals as distant phantom weeping echoes from the canopy.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: A sharp tang of pickled vinegar hangs in the humid air as a pale, bioluminescent silhouette drifts silently past the upper windows.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Glistening loops of bioluminescent viscera trail beneath a detached, floating head that drips caustic, vinegar-reeking bile.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: A floating predator's head wreathed in ghostly green marsh-fire trails glowing spectral sinews through the night air.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Dry leaves ignite without smoke as an inverted sphere of roaring orange embers walks upside-down on tongues of living flame.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: A blistered, upside-down skull wreathed in white-hot tallow fire spits blistering cinders that char flesh on contact.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: An inverted, roaring beast of living plasma stalks across the ceiling on claws of blue-white fire.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Puddles flow uphill toward the storm drains, carrying the briny stench of deep river silt and rhythmic, bubbling whispers.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Bloated, waterlogged tendrils of dark river-kelp and drowned cartilage surge from the drains to drag prey under.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: A sleek, gill-slitted amphibious predator rises from the brackish tide with glowing lure-whiskers.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Velvet-draped antlers scrape against overhead girders as a tinny, distorted recording of a distressed bystander repeats from the treeline.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Tattered rib-skin stretches tight over an elongated, frost-blackened cervine skull that weeps steaming crimson tallow.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Towering, frost-encrusted Lupine-Stag hybrid limbs uncoil from the shadows as its jaws echo stolen radio voices.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Streetlights hum at a tooth-aching pitch and compass needles spin wildly as twin car-taillight eyes flare atop a ten-foot wingspan.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Compound eyes bleeding static-charged ichor stare from a thorax of fused transformer coils and leathery membrane.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Thick, static-crackling moth-fur and radar-broad antennae silhouette against the high-voltage tower.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: The harsh scrape of ceramic and concrete against tile stops the exact millisecond your eyes snap toward the corner.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Cracked fiberglass joints leak dried rust and spinal fluid, freezing mid-lunge with its porcelain fingers inches from your carotid.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: A articulated porcelain-and-rebar beast mannequin freezes mid-pounce whenever held in direct sight.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Headlights flick on behind tinted, empty windshields as a mechanical fare-meter ticks upward in time with your pulse.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Locked doors seal with a wet pneumatic hiss as the upholstery parts to revealdigestive ribs beneath the leather seats.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: The radiator grille gnashes like articulated steel jaws as low, engine-revving growls vibrate through the asphalt.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Despite the severed power cord, snow-static blooms across the screen and a voice addresses you by your childhood nickname.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Coaxial cables writhe like optic nerves as the speaker cone weeps warm plasma and projects a retina-searing fractal.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Phosphor-green lupine eyes resolve inside the unplugged monitor static, mouthing words that bypass your eardrums.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Every exit door opens back into the exact same corridor three seconds in the past, while the ceiling slowly tilts ninety degrees.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: The walls breathe with a wet, peristaltic rhythm as spatial folds splice organic tissue into the wallpaper.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Clawed footprints walk across the ceiling and walls in an impossible Möbius loop around the chamber.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Ventilation shafts pulse with a warm, humid breath as bioluminescent filaments weave across the concrete like living capillaries.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: A writhing tapestry of grafted vocal cords and ossified ribs unfurls from the ductwork, exhaling aerosolized crimson spores.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: A multi-limbed pack of spore-fused therian hounds moves with a single synchronized hive-heartbeat.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Suspended three inches above its pedestal, the artifact hums with a predatory resonance that tugs at the iron in your blood.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Serrated bone-metal teeth along the weapon's spine twitch hungrily, weeping warm condensation that etches the floor.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Carved beast-fangs along the hilt snap shut on empty air, projecting a spectral predator silhouette.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Loose change clinks playfully in empty air as autumn leaves swirl into counterfeit banknotes and nearby exit signs swap arrows with a muffled giggle.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Stitched pelt-seams ripple with a wet chuckle as illusory coins melt into twitching, blood-veined camellia leaves across the counter.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: A ringed raccoon-dog tail flicks behind a shimmering mirage stall as a grinning muzzle tips a woven sedge hat.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Glass marbles clatter across the floor on their own while bootlaces untie themselves and small coins stack into neat, teasing spirals.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Tiny, chalk-pale footprints glistening with green amniotic dew dart around scattered marbles as a shrill giggle echoes from the rafters.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: Huge, saucer-bright nocturnal tarsier eyes blink mischievously from the rafters while nimble paws juggle gleaming brass coins.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: Drawers slam in a syncopated drumbeat while keys, pens, and soda cans orbit the ceiling light in a mocking carousel.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Rusted surgical trays and shattered mirror shards whirl in a manic figure-eight as invisible fingernails drum a jaunty rhythm on the walls.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: A static-furred spectral mustelid cackles from inside a rattling locker, juggling stolen keyrings and glowing fuses.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: A single wooden clog thuds rhythmically around the blind corner before an oiled-paper umbrella pops open with a wide, delighted eye.
folklore_scp_motifs.gore_omen: Bloodshot scleral veins bulge inside oiled skin-parchment as a yard-long, Indigo-stained tongue unfurls inches from your cheek for the sheer thrill of your gasp.
folklore_scp_motifs.furry_omen: A furry, clawed monopod hops out from behind a wet lantern post, flaring painted beast-eyespots with a theatrical hiss.

folklore_scp_motifs.base_omen: A hunched bystander with shoulders shaking in quiet sobs slowly turns beneath the flickering lamp, wiping a hand across an egg-smooth, featureless face.

dialogue_traps.prompt_question: 'Tell me honestly—can you see my face clearly right now?'
dialogue_traps.evasive_label: Reply evasively: 'The streetlight is flickering—everything looks indistinct tonight'
dialogue_traps.success_note: Your non-committal answer stalled its binary recognition contract, dropping its guard!
dialogue_traps.fail_note: Answering its binary trap directly fulfilled its recognition clause!

dialogue_traps.prompt_question: 'Will you take the red ticket or the white ticket for the last train?'
dialogue_traps.evasive_label: Show your own pass: 'Neither—I am only inspecting the platform'
dialogue_traps.success_note: Declining both cursed tickets broke the conductor's binary fare-loop!
dialogue_traps.fail_note: Choosing either cursed ticket bound you to its phantom fare penalty!

omen_paradoxes.rule_summary: Inverse Acoustic Distance: Loud crying or footsteps mean the anomaly is still far off; faint, barely audible sounds mean it is directly beside you.
omen_paradoxes.observe_hint: Wait—its acoustics are inverted! As the sound fades to a whisper, frost blooms right beside your boot!

omen_paradoxes.rule_summary: Reverse Shadow Bearing: Its visible silhouette projects across the room from its true physical anchor point.
omen_paradoxes.observe_hint: Careful—its optical glare points opposite its real Hume anchor behind the pillar!
